items.title: Strategy buys 1,036 Bitcoin as BTC holdings climb to 850,364
items.summary: Strategy bought $81.9 million in Bitcoin last week while spending $188.3 million repurchasing STRC preferred shares, according to its latest SEC filing.

items.title: ‘Connecting the dots’: Michael Saylor’s Strategy buys another 1,036 bitcoin for $82 million as holdings top 850,000 BTC
items.summary: Strategy's total holdings account for more than 4% of bitcoin's supply cap, with $500 million in paper gains.

items.title: Bitcoin bulls can't rely on ETF flows
Bitcoin ETFs shed $1.3B in biggest weekly outflow since late June
items.summary: Investors pulled a net $1.21 billion from BlackRock’s IBIT last week as Bitcoin fell below $76,000 and US technology stocks sold off.
